name: warden
description: Warden - encrypted, locally-hosted personal document vault. This root package.json is a coordinating layer only (via `concurrently`) - it does not replace server/package.json or client/package.json. See README.md.
_predevComment: npm runs 'predev' automatically before 'dev', with no separate step needed. Two independent problems it fixes on every start: (1) scripts/ensure-cert.js auto-detects this PC's current LAN IP and regenerates certs/localhost+3.pem to cover it if it's missing (quiet no-op otherwise), so switching networks never again means a stale cert / false first-run-setup screen. (2) A leftover Node process from a previous dev session (esp. on Windows, where a stopped npm run dev can leave node.exe behind - see README troubleshooting) has repeatedly held onto ports 5000/5173, causing either a hard EADDRINUSE crash on the backend or Vite silently bumping to 5174 (a port not in CORS_ORIGINS, so the frontend can't reach the API) - npx kill-port frees both before every start regardless of what happened last session.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --host"
